subject.title: [Feature]: Deeplink/contentIntent support in system.notify for Android nodes

question: Should Android `system.notify` accept a notification-tap deeplink/contentIntent, and if so must it share an allowlisted URL-launch policy or be limited to OpenClaw-owned destinations?
rationale: The implementation can be small, but the behavior crosses a native Android app-launch boundary and overlaps the broader deeplink-launch issue, so automation should not choose the security policy.

options.title: Allowlisted Notification Deeplinks
options.body: Permit notification taps only through a maintainer-approved scheme/host allowlist shared with the Android URL/deeplink launch policy.

options.title: OpenClaw-Only Notification Taps
options.body: Support only OpenClaw-owned app routes from notifications and leave arbitrary companion-app deeplinks to a separate command.

options.title: No Native Tap Launch
options.body: Keep Android `system.notify` display-only until a broader Android deeplink command is designed.

recommendation.title: Allowlisted Notification Deeplinks
recommendation.body: Permit notification taps only through a maintainer-approved scheme/host allowlist shared with the Android URL/deeplink launch policy.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the current issue assignee for this maintainer decision, while @obviyus is the strongest Android code owner candidate.
